      ],
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "url = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbrownlee/Datasets/master/airline-passengers.csv\"\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(url)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "print(\"\\nDataset Shape:\", df.shape)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Check data types and missing values\n",
        "print(df.info())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nMissing values:\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert Month column to datetime\n",
        "df['Month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Month'])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check duplicate rows\n",
        "print(\"\\nDuplicate rows:\", df.duplicated().sum())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "acBqA4hddM4y",
        "outputId": "6f25b523-a03d-4a05-a6f7-927604393576"

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(df['Month'], df['Passengers'], marker='o')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title('Historical Airline Passenger Trends')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Month')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Number of Passengers')\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 139
        },
        "id": "ddNxms16dYV5",
        "outputId": "cd056e8f-ceb0-4dfc-8f1f-660b99c1aae9"
      },
      "execution_count": null,

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create time-based features\n",
        "df['Year'] = df['Month'].dt.year\n",
        "df['Month_Number'] = df['Month'].dt.month\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select input features and target\n",
        "X = df[['Year', 'Month_Number']]\n",
        "y = df['Passengers']\n",
        "\n",
        "# Split data in chronological order\n",
        "split_index = int(len(df) * 0.8)\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train = X.iloc[:split_index]\n",
        "X_test = X.iloc[split_index:]\n",
        "\n",
        "y_train = y.iloc[:split_index]\n",
        "y_test = y.iloc[split_index:]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training records:\", len(X_train))\n",
        "print(\"Testing records:\", len(X_test))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "z81JulJeeC0k",
        "outputId": "1357db3b-7cff-428e-bd98-5bb43d7a76b8"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training records: 115\n",
            "Testing records: 29\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create and train the model\n",
        "model = LinearRegression()\n",
        "\n",
        "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Linear Regression model trained successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "y4YtczAUeaIO",
        "outputId": "89d23fbf-fb20-4676-e332-b6b9e5bb4d0e"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Linear Regression model trained successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Predict passenger numbers\n",
        "y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Compare actual and predicted values\n",
        "results = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    'Actual Passengers': y_test.values,\n",
        "    'Predicted Passengers': y_pred.round(0)\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "print(results.head(10))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "8lCcoK3Jer2p",

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score\n",
        "\n",
        "mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Model Evaluation:\")\n",
        "print(\"MAE:\", round(mae, 2))\n",
        "print(\"MSE:\", round(mse, 2))\n",
        "print(\"R2 Score:\", round(r2, 3))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "6Cn2Qsp5fHce",
        "outputId": "541b87fe-5790-4b68-faa9-8bf7d10b317d"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Model Evaluation:\n",

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create improved features\n",
        "X2 = pd.get_dummies(\n",
        "    df['Month_Number'],\n",
        "    prefix='Month',\n",
        "    drop_first=True,\n",
        "    dtype=int\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "X2['Year_Trend'] = df['Year'] - df['Year'].min()\n",
        "X2['Year_Trend_Squared'] = X2['Year_Trend'] ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "# Split chronologically\n",
        "X2_train = X2.iloc[:split_index]\n",
        "X2_test = X2.iloc[split_index:]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train improved model\n",
        "model2 = LinearRegression()\n",
        "model2.fit(X2_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predict\n",
        "y_pred2 = model2.predict(X2_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Evaluate\n",
        "print(\"Improved Model Evaluation:\")\n",
        "print(\"MAE:\", round(mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred2), 2))\n",
        "print(\"MSE:\", round(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred2), 2))\n",
        "print(\"R2 Score:\", round(r2_score(y_test, y_pred2), 3))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "7YlTZnHKfprZ",
        "outputId": "085a2030-87a1-4e35-8c60-50bab49d0f84"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Improved Model Evaluation:\n",
            "MAE: 35.59\n",
            "MSE: 1754.4\n",
            "R2 Score: 0.713\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    df['Month'].iloc[split_index:],\n",
        "    y_test.values,\n",
        "    label='Actual Passengers',\n",
        "    marker='o'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    df['Month'].iloc[split_index:],\n",
        "    y_pred2,\n",
        "    label='Predicted Passengers',\n",
        "    marker='x'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title('Actual vs Predicted Airline Passengers')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Month')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Number of Passengers')\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Create future dates for the next 12 months\n",
        "future_dates = pd.date_range(\n",
        "    start=df['Month'].max() + pd.offsets.MonthBegin(1),\n",
        "    periods=12,\n",
        "    freq='MS'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "future_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    'Month': future_dates\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "future_df['Year'] = future_df['Month'].dt.year\n",
        "future_df['Month_Number'] = future_df['Month'].dt.month\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create same features as improved model\n",
        "future_X = pd.get_dummies(\n",
        "    future_df['Month_Number'],\n",
        "    prefix='Month',\n",
        "    drop_first=True,\n",
        "    dtype=int\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "future_X['Year_Trend'] = future_df['Year'] - df['Year'].min()\n",
        "future_X['Year_Trend_Squared'] = future_X['Year_Trend'] ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ensure future features match training columns\n",
        "future_X = future_X.reindex(columns=X2_train.columns, fill_value=0)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predict future passengers\n",
        "future_df['Predicted_Passengers'] = model2.predict(future_X).round(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(future_df[['Month', 'Predicted_Passengers']])"
      ],
      "metadata": {
